notes.title: Update Ver1.05
notes.content:
I am sorry that the update support was delayed because I am busy for personal reasons.
In this update, we mainly made improvements based on your opinions.
Please play again if you like.

[h2]Improvement[/h2]
- When an ally leaves the player, it will respawn near the player.
 They will not be stuck in the terrain.
- If the character goes out of the map for some reason, it will die, but now it will respawn.
 (In the case of a player, in the initial position, in the case of an ally, near the player)
- Orange markers have been displayed on enemy characters targeted for missions to make them easier to recognize.
- A marker is displayed at the position when an ally dies to make it easier to recognize.
- On the point usage screen, you can now not only assign points but also cancel them.
- The message can be advanced by clicking the mouse on the conversation screen.
- Reviewed the orientation of the light source on the map.
- Optimized internal processing.

[h2]Balance adjustment[/h2]
- The rate of increase in attack power depending on the level of the weapon has been revised downward.
 I think it's hard to die even if there is a level difference.
- When the stage is completed, the level of team members will be raised by one as a bonus.
 As an aside, experience points are shared by the team, and experience points will increase no matter who defeats the enemy.
 Also, as the player level increases, the surviving allies will also level up.
- The size of the boss monster has been increased slightly.
- Changed the size of the automatically created map to be slightly larger.
- Adjusted the bullet size of some weapons.
- Reduced the volume of the explosion a little.
- The vibration of the controller has been reduced.
- Adjusted the amount of knockback when hit by a bullet.
- Reduced the normal spawn frequency of enemies

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
- Fixed the problem that there was no hit judgment on a part of the terrain of the forest map.
- Fixed the problem that the fire was fired only once when clicked on various menu screens.
 Only the key corresponding to each scene was accepted.
- Fixed an issue where allies would move back and forth with the player trying to return to their initial spawn position.
- Fixed an issue where music would break if there was a lot of sound.

[h2]Other[/h2]
- If a problem such as the key not working occurs because the area around the key map has been reviewed or added, Try resetting the keymap.

notes.title: Update Ver1.04
notes.content:
This update continues from before, Major changes in internal processing that are the premise of implementing the multiplayer function, The game system and map were changed.

I think you can enjoy it even more.

[h1]Game system changes[/h1]
- Set up several mission areas. The next mission area appears at the end of the mission.
- Coins / recovery drugs / weapons (low probability) appear at the end of the mission.
- A boss area appears when all missions are completed.
- Abolished movement limit area in boss area.
- Changed the stage end area so that it appears after boss defeated.
- Weapons now appear when the boss is defeated.
- Changed so that normal enemies that appear once reappear after a while.
- Changed the composition of the terrain and enemy appearance position of all stages.
- Reviewed music at some stages.

[h1]Internal processing changes[/h1]
- Subdivision of linkage processing with multiplayer function and change to event driven type.
- Review the scene movement process.
- Changed input system to be assigned to each player.

[h1]Change screen[/h1]
- The player's level / avatar / health / stamina / experience value bar is displayed at the top left of the screen.
- Detailed information on player health / experience values can be viewed on the inventory screen.
- Delete health value above character
- Abolish normal enemy marks from indicators around the screen
- The weapon type of the team member was displayed.

- Separate tutorial into dedicated scenes.

[h1]Improved processing capacity[/h1]
- Pause AI (enemy / team member) away from the player
- Review the processing speed of the enemy discovery routine.
- Review of rendering process
- Changed the character shadow to a simplified version.
- Reduction of excessive effects

[h1]Other[/h1]
- Slightly modified strength / speed of Bee / Wolf
- Changed the maximum number of items to be changed from 99 to 9999.

notes.title: Update Ver1.02
notes.content:
I started to consider online multiplayer function. However, since the current game system does not assume multiplayer, it is necessary to review the base system. Also, since it is the first multiplayer development, I think it will take some time.

This update mainly improves the frame rate prior to multiplayer support. Since there is still room for improvement, I would like to make improvements.

[h1]Improved frame rate[/h1]
- Changed the engine used from Unity 2018 to 2019
- Reviewed the Pooling system for Spawn processing of characters and bullets. As a result, the frame rate improved by about 1.5 to 2 times.
- The model shadow was not displayed because it was output excessively.
- Removed display of character footprint (smoke).
- Fixed a problem that the frame rate dropped significantly when ACS17 appeared.

[h1]Adjustment[/h1]
- Reload time of handgun / submachine gun is slightly faster and range is slightly longer.
- SciFi-Assault Rifle is too strong, so Damage / MagazineSize has been revised slightly downward.
- Since the rocket launcher / missile launcher vibrates too much, it is slightly mild.
- Slightly less because the player jumped too much.
- The bandage appearance rate was increased because there were too many flesh appearances in the early stages.

[h1]Other[/h1]
- Revised the navigation mesh of the map so that characters do not appear in the terrain.
- Increased the voice variation when a human character defeated.
- Added a function to display a list of team members at the top left of the screen.

notes.title: Improvement update
notes.content:
This update improves the following:

-The display processing of information above the character has been reviewed to reduce the FPS drop during enemy spawn.
-In order to prevent the display of Health / EXP / Coin from becoming longer, K / M / B and exponent display are supported. The damage value was kept long to emphasize the strength.

notes.title: Fixed overflow of health and coin values
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the health value would become negative as the level increased. These were held in int variables (up to 2147483647), but changed to handle long values (up to 9223372036854775807). In addition, the upper limit check of the long value has been tightened so that it does not become a negative value.
The same correction was made for Coin.

In addition, since it was found that the value would be larger than expected on the development side, the increase factor by character level / weapon level was reduced so that it was difficult to reach the upper limit. Since the factors for both health and weapons damage are reduced, the numerical value will be smaller, but the overall difficulty will not change.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
[h1]Improvement[/h1]
- The initialization process has been revised for situations where FPS drops when an enemy appears. In addition, the occurrence of garbage collection was suppressed.

[h1]Bug fix[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where light machine gun bullets would sometimes pass without hitting continuously.

notes.title: Improved path finding algorithm
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35949980/0118ba525ac5fff16326612f1149c7def6b03371.png[/img]

The route search for AI movements of enemies and team members is performed using a movable area called Navimesh. If the source or destination is outside this area, it cannot be searched, so far it has simply been directed forward to the destination. For this reason, there were cases where it was not possible to proceed by hitting an obstacle outside the area.

This time, the route search start and end positions are used as route search points near them to improve the route search more accurately.
